name: Pesmenben IV
description: Pesmenben IV was an Imperial planet in the Mid Rim's Teraab sector that had ore deposits and dunes. At one point by 0 BBY, the businessman Lando Calrissian duped the planet's Imperial governor into leasing it by pulling a scam involving lithium.
